entities.summary: Krzysztof Korwin Gosiewski de armis Ślepowron was the Palatine-Governor of Smolensk from 1639, Secretary of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania since 1638, Lithuanian Great-Quartermaster since 1625, District-Governor of Velizh and a diplomat. He was the son of Aleksander Korwin Gosiewski and Ewa Pac.
